_README: Single source of truth for the K-Bound paper's result-table numbers. These are the HONEST OUT-OF-FOLD values (NOT protocol_result.json::test_locked, which uses an in-sample radius and overstates Office-Home/iWildCam as beats-both). After a multi-seed/tuning re-run, refresh these fields from the out-of-fold evaluation, then run scripts/make_tables.py to regenerate paper/generated/kbound_numbers.tex, then rebuild the PDFs. Numbers below match the current committed PDFs exactly.
